summary.text: Ryan Weldon is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 41 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Weldon's career experience as a digital business development manager, and he previously served on the Ankeny school board.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Weldon's career experience includes working as a digital business development manager, as well as in insurance, men's fashion, banking, FinTech, nonprofits and IT, according to Ballotpedia.
Weldon previously served on the Ankeny school board.
In the 2025-2026 session Weldon was assigned to the Economic Growth, House Education, House Human Resources and Labor committees.
